FIELD OFFICER STAFFING — HR extract, September 2026
Dhaka division: 820 field officers · Mymensingh division: 630 field officers
Total: 1,450 field officers

extraction.value: Paper loan forms get lost or come back incomplete, so a loan takes about 9 working days from application to disbursement.
Let field officers complete loan applications on a tablet in the field and send them to the branch manager for approval the same day.
Field officers (enter applications) and branch managers (approve).
Pilot in 120 branches in the Dhaka and Mymensingh divisions.
Loan application entry on a tablet, borrower photo and national ID capture, offline storage and sync, branch manager approval.
Before July 2027 (start of the next fiscal year).
Many villages have weak or no mobile data; the app must work without the internet.

why: Both are tablet apps for field officers
Both must work offline in villages with weak mobile data
Same users: field officers and branch managers

sections.title: Non-functional requirements
sections.excerpt: The app works fully offline and syncs to the Collection Server every 30 minutes when a connection is available.

sections.title: Risks, assumptions and constraints
sections.excerpt: Field officers may resist moving from paper; run paper and app side by side for two weeks at 10 pilot branches.

sections.title: Hosting and devices
sections.excerpt: Tablets are managed with TabSecure MDM so the app can be updated remotely and wiped if lost.

why: Same users (field officers and branch managers)
Uses loan application and approval data

sections.title: Objectives and success criteria
sections.excerpt: Cut loan processing time from 7 working days to 2 working days for at least 90% of applications.

sections.title: Reporting needs
sections.excerpt: Branch managers need a daily list of pending loan applications and their age.

suggestions.text: The app must work fully offline and sync automatically when a connection returns, showing the time of the last successful sync. Data syncs to the Collection Server every 30 minutes.
Field officers may resist moving from paper. Run paper and the app side by side for two weeks at 10 pilot branches, with a field champion in each branch.
Cut loan processing time from 7 working days to 2 working days for at least 90% of applications in the pilot branches.
Manage the tablets with the existing mobile device management service (TabSecure MDM) so the app can be updated remotely and wiped if a tablet is lost.
Capture the member's photo and GPS location with each application, and refuse to submit when the location is older than 15 minutes.

regen.PROPOSAL:objectives:
1. **Faster loans:** bring the time from application to disbursement down from about 9 working days, meeting the success criteria below.
2. **Complete applications:** the app checks every required field before an application can be submitted.
3. **Same-day approval:** branch managers approve in the app on the day the application is entered.

**Success criteria:** {{fact:success_criteria}}

PROPOSAL: Reduce loan processing time in the pilot branches.
Make every submitted loan application complete and checked.
Let branch managers approve applications on the same day.
BRD: Field officers can fill in a loan application on a tablet without an internet connection.
The app captures the member's photo and national ID with each application.
An application cannot be submitted while required fields are missing.
Branch managers approve or return applications in the app.
Loans above BDT 1 lakh go to the area manager for approval.
Managers see a daily list of pending applications per branch.
SRS: The app stores applications on the tablet when offline and syncs them when a connection returns.
The app shows the time of the last successful sync.
The app takes the member's photo and scans the national ID card with the tablet camera.
The app validates required fields and blocks submission until they are complete.
Branch managers see submitted applications and can approve or return them with a reason.
Applications above BDT 1 lakh are routed to the area manager after branch approval.
A dashboard lists pending applications per branch with their age in days.
Field officers can change the app language between Bangla and English.

segments.speaker: u-pm
segments.raw: আজকের মিটিং এর বিষয় পাইলোট শাকা নির্বাচন। আমরা কি একশো বিশটা শাকায় একসাথে শুরু করবো?
segments.corrected: আজকের মিটিংয়ের বিষয় পাইলট শাখা নির্বাচন। আমরা কি একশো বিশটা শাখায় একসাথে শুরু করবো?

segments.speaker: u-sh
segments.raw: আমার মনে হয় প্রথমে ময়মন সিংহের বিশটা শাকায় শুরু করা ভালো, তারপর বাকি একশো টা।
segments.corrected: আমার মনে হয় প্রথমে ময়মনসিংহের বিশটা শাখায় শুরু করা ভালো, তারপর বাকি একশোটা।

segments.speaker: u-tech
segments.raw: অফলাইন সিঙ্ক এর জন্য আমাদের আরো দুই সপ্তা টেস্টিং লাগবে।
segments.corrected: অফলাইন সিঙ্কের জন্য আমাদের আরও দুই সপ্তাহ টেস্টিং লাগবে।

segments.speaker: u-sp
segments.raw: বাজেট এক কোটি আশি লাক এর মধ্যে থাকতে হবে।
segments.corrected: বাজেট এক কোটি আশি লাখের মধ্যে থাকতে হবে।

segments.speaker: u-pm
segments.raw: ঠিক আছে, তাহলে শাকা ব্যাবস্থাপক এক লাখ টাকা পর্যন্ত লোন অনুমোদন করবেন।
segments.corrected: ঠিক আছে, তাহলে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক এক লাখ টাকা পর্যন্ত লোন অনুমোদন করবেন।

decisions.text: Start the pilot in 20 branches in Mymensingh, then extend to the remaining 100 branches.
Allow two extra weeks of testing for offline sync.
Branch managers approve loans up to BDT 1 lakh in the app.
Keep the total budget within BDT 1.8 crore.
